text: The McCormick and Bill Bolton Arena Nominating Panel on March 22, 2018, considered a report (March 14, 2018) from the City Clerk respecting the appointment of members to the McCormick Playground Arena Board.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Appointed the following candidate to the McCormick Playground Arena Board, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending on February 22, 2021, and until a successor is appointed: - Patrick Rettig 2. Directed that Confidential Attachments 1, 2 and 3 to the report (March 14, 2018) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the McCormick Playground Arena Board.
